			NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_mastered_works target = flag:work_shiur_qomah } }
			any_in_global_list = {
				variable = kehillah_registered_communities
				NOT = { this = root.primary_title }
				exists = holder
				is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_shiur_qomah }
			}
		}
		add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_journey_offer_works target = flag:work_shiur_qomah }
		if = {
			limit = { primary_title = { NOT = { is_target_in_variable_list = { name = kehillah_library_works target = flag:work_shiur_qomah } } } }
			add_to_variable_list = { name = kehillah_journey_offer_priority target = flag:work_shiur_qomah }
		}
	}
